scripts.build:css: sass --silence-deprecation color-functions --silence-deprecation global-builtin --silence-deprecation import src/scss/custom.scss dist/assets/css/custom.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p dist && cpy static/ *.html *.xml .nojekyll robots.txt dist
scripts.build: npm run build:copy && npm run build:css
scripts.serve: npm run build && concurrently "chokidar 'src/**/*' 'static/**/*' '*.html' -c 'npm run build' -i 200" "browser-sync start --server dist --files 'dist/**/*' --no-open --port 3000"
